verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated fallbacks feature on the Universal endpoint. It sends a request to one provider (e.g. Workers AI) and proceeds to another (e.g. OpenAI) on failure. Fallback triggers on request errors or predetermined timeouts, and the `cf-aig-step` header reports which step served the request. Dynamic Routing adds configurable fallback flows, set up through a visual or JSON configuration, that can be changed without touching application code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that fallback works as documented.
